notes: Three isnads of one saying: the first is a full route; «وحدثنيه» and the «ح» give the second and third, which meet only through «ابن شهاب» in the third
The second route ends at يونس as the text writes it: ابن شهاب is named only in the third route, so no tail is applied to it (rule 3 would give يونس the student يعقوب). Needs a reader's check
«ابن أخي» and «ابن شهاب» are written as two links, split by the comma as the text gives them; the nephew's identity is not decided
